decision: No new simulator or workload is warranted until one compatible controller-level calibration record binds sustainable mixed64B payload,usable class response/ack latency and complete energy under the retained windows/address map at one declared operating point. Preserve1MiB and1.5MiB as conditional candidates; neither is physically selected. The retained C four-private-context shared-FU point exceeds8GiB for both at2GHz, independent of optimistic external bandwidth.
energy_decision: At equal4000contexts,1.5MiB adds1.953125GiB local data and the rounded envelope saves79.375G64Btransactions/s. If complete external cost is e_nJ/64B,at most79.375*e_nJ W is available to pay extra local dynamic,leakage,control/routing;40.64*e_nJ W/GiB before local-dynamic overhead. Different stalls can change context/engine count and reverse the apparent capacity cost; do not use equal-residence cancellation as actual power.
exact_blocker: Retained HBM2 measured current model is not joined to exact tested device/MR,rank,row mapping,shared command/turnaround,temperature refresh and PHY usable-return timings. HBM-Power is not a command-legal service scheduler. Service39 finite scheduler is pinned but hardcoded to a different256KiB+16KiB policy and assumed timings; there is no qualified existing command for1MiB/1.5MiB.
sensitivity_scope: Necessary steady-state credit/storage conditions only: retained B resources,one context/engine,2dataset and2backing64Bchild credits/context,assumed >=8Mclocks residence at2GHz,full64B return plus owner storage charged in FRONTIER. If latency requires more contexts, engines and private images increase with them. Additional staging/issue/RF/controller/power and achievable full-hash schedules remain unknown. Not the rejected C four-slot resource point.
